definitions: To be inadequately prepared for a confrontation or challenge.
To enter a situation with insufficient resources or tools.
examples: He brought a knife to a gunfight by not studying for the exam.
Trying to negotiate without any leverage is bringing a knife to a gunfight.
Their small budget for the project meant they were bringing a knife to a gunfight.
lemma: to bring a knife to a gunfight
